analysis_status: designed after sampling-effort sensitivity of binary link states was established; detection-standardized ecological association only, not confirmatory rewiring
purpose: Replace binary gain/loss as the ecological response with focal-dyad interaction incidence per identifiable 5-min focal-plant census, so unequal focal-plant observation intensity enters as the binomial denominator rather than defining link presence.

sources.period_rule: the same externally documented early/mid/late boundaries used in the raw 18-period reconstruction

census_semantics.response_success: the focal pollinator is recorded with no.fl.visit > 0 in that focal-plant census
census_semantics.response_trials: number of identifiable 5-min censuses for the focal plant in the current subseason

candidate_dyad_surface.plant_requirement: focal plant has at least one identifiable census in both adjacent subseasons
candidate_dyad_surface.pollinator_requirement: focal pollinator is detected on at least one other plant in both adjacent subseasons
candidate_dyad_surface.focal_response_exclusion: the focal plant-pollinator interaction is never used to establish pollinator presence or the opportunity predictor
candidate_dyad_surface.reason: avoid defining the analysis surface from the same focal binary link state being modeled

predictors.history: Jeffreys-smoothed previous-period focal interaction detection rate, transformed to logit scale: (successes + 0.5)/(trials + 1)
predictors.current_siteweek_opportunity: fraction of current focal-plant site x ISO-week cells in which the focal pollinator is detected on at least one other plant

model.family: aggregated binomial logistic regression using current positive-census count out of current focal-plant census count
model.promotion_rule: current opportunity may be described as reproducible incremental information only if pooled held-out log loss improves and the full-minus-baseline improvement has the same positive direction in every primary held-out transition

interpretation.allowed: current focal-response-excluded spatiotemporal opportunity carries held-out information about per-census interaction incidence beyond recent interaction history under an effort-standardized response

claim_ceiling: This analysis standardizes the response for unequal focal-plant census effort by modeling interaction detections out of observed 5-min censuses. It can support an ecological opportunity association in observed interaction incidence, but it does not identify latent links, true rewiring, causality, or routeability.
